The asymmetric outer arch and diagonally cut internal opening create a specific visible relationship, although the first association remains an arch or lowercase-n family. This is a limited visual judgment, not a uniqueness study.

The heavy top compresses the opening; the left inner top is broadly rounded while the right inner top has an abrupt turn.
Only the large native PNG was inspected; actual 32–64px behavior remains unverified.

reason: The off-centre arch and diagonal counter create a viable relationship worth one optical refinement. Reduce excess top weight and regularize the abrupt interior turn without losing the asymmetric character.
preserve: The asymmetric outer arch, its current outer silhouette and baseline
Diagonal internal top edge, open bottom, confident ink weight, flat ink on white, no lettering
